The top open-source ERP systems that handle both production and stock management are ERPNext and Odoo, both offering robust manufacturing and inventory modules.
Comparison of Top Open-Source ERP Systems
Key Open-Source Options
ERPNext: : A comprehensive open-source platform with a polished user interface. Its manufacturing module supports Bill of Materials (BOM), operations, production planning, and shop floor tracking, while tightly binding with multi-location inventory and automated stock reordering.
Odoo (Community Edition): : Highly popular and modular. The manufacturing app handles multi-level BOMs and work orders, while the inventory app supports double-entry inventory tracking, scrap management, and barcode scanning. (Note: Advanced enterprise features often require paid upgrades or the proprietary Enterprise license).
Metasfresh: : An agile open-source ERP tailored for mid-sized manufacturers and wholesale distributors. It excels in handling fast-moving inventory, flexible shipping logistics, and detailed production workflows.
Apache OFBiz: : A mature, enterprise-grade framework and ERP suite. It includes extensive out-of-the-box components for manufacturing, warehouse management, and asset maintenance, best suited for teams with in-house developers.
